DisplayName.value: Kitsune Loads ~ Cats of 7 Days: Spring

Description.value: Cats of 7 Days, the spring edition: Kevin the tabby enjoys the thaw while the wasteland turns green and the zombies get in the way. 12 widescreen scenes (the thaw, seedlings, spring rain, cherry blossoms, chicks, wildflower meadow, beehives, muddy minibike, laundry day, hilltop picnic, a nest in a wreck, blood moon over the tulips) rotate at random every time the loading screen appears. Mutually exclusive with the other KitsuneLoads packs ~ install one or the other.
